name: value_literal
content: If the design assigns a fixed literal (e.g., assign y = 1'b0; or parameter N = 4;), flip or slightly alter that literal once so that functionality changes but syntax remains correct.

name: expr_operator_flip
content: If the design contains an expression or comparison (==, !=, &, |, ^), replace exactly one operator with another valid one to alter logic but keep the code compiling.

name: comparison_operator
content: Replace one comparison operator (==, !=, <, <=, >, >=) with a similar but incorrect one.

name: arithmetic_operator
content: Replace one arithmetic operator (+, -, *, /, %) with another valid operator, or perturb one operand constant by ±1.

name: bitwise_operator
content: Change one bitwise or shift operator (&, |, ^, ~, <<, >>) to a different valid operator at one location.

name: reset_polarity_flip
content: If a synchronous or asynchronous reset exists, invert its polarity once (if(rst)→if(!rst)) and adjust any negedge/posedge sensitivity as needed.

name: off_by_one_counter
content: In a counter or loop, modify exactly one terminal comparison or increment/decrement by ±1.

name: blocking_nonblocking_swap_seq
content: In a sequential always block, replace one non-blocking assignment with a blocking assignment or vice versa, preserving syntax.

name: width_mismatch
content: Alter one signal or slice width so an assignment truncates or zero-extends but still compiles.

name: logic_error
content: Change one logical operator (&&, ||, !) or its sense to alter control flow while keeping valid syntax.

name: assignment_style
content: In a combinational block, change one assignment style from blocking to non-blocking or vice versa.

name: initialization_fault
content: Change one reset or initial value constant to a wrong value but still legal.

name: data_handling
content: Alter one data-handling operation such as signedness, concatenation, or cast ($signed, literal base, endian).

name: state_machine
content: In an FSM, change one next-state transition, assignment, or encoding constant.

name: condition_negation
content: Negate or narrow one if/case condition while keeping it syntactically correct.

name: condition_priority
content: Reorder one branch in a nested if/else or case so priority changes.

name: signal_declaration
content: Change one signal’s declaration (width, direction, reg/wire/logic) to a still-compiling incorrect version.

name: other_minor
content: Apply a minor compiling change not covered above (e.g., reorder statements, remove redundant wire).
